description: This file defines a Minimax image generation provider for an openclaw plugin SDK, including functions to build provider objects, handle API requests, and process responses for image generation.

methods.name: resolveMinimaxImageBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for Minimax API, defaulting to a constant if configuration is missing or invalid.

methods.name: buildMinimaxImageProvider
methods.description: Constructs an ImageGenerationProvider object with capabilities and generateImage method for Minimax.
